title: Parseval identity for the twisted lift
statement:
Let $k \ge 1$ and $n \ge 0$ be integers, and write $\omega_k = e^{2\pi i/k}$. Fix $j \in \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$ and an arbitrary function $f : \mathbb{Z}_k^n \to \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$, and let $\widetilde{f}_j : \mathbb{Z}_k^n \to \mathbb{C}$ be the $j$-twisted lift given by $\widetilde{f}_j(x) = \omega_k^{\,j\cdot f(x)}$, with Fourier coefficients $\widehat{\widetilde{f}_j}(s)$ indexed by the frequencies $s \in \mathbb{Z}_k^n$. Then
\[
  \sum_{s \in \mathbb{Z}_k^n} \bigl\lvert \widehat{\widetilde{f}_j}(s) \bigr\rvert^{2} = 1.
\]
hypotheses_covered: sum over all frequencies s ∈ ℤ_k^n of the squared modulus of the Fourier coefficient of the j-twisted lift
